items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 2490.0/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-07-12 was Rs 2490.0/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 199.69-5396.3/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +58.0% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 3934.51/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 2490.0/MWh, a +58.0% divergence.
